subject: English Language
source_note: TIE (2023), English Language Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Manage information search from different sources for lifelong learning

sub_topics.title: Organise information obtained from different sources
competences: (a) Identify different ways/strategies for organising information from various sources
(b) Sort and categorise information obtained from various sources into related themes
(c) Compile information searched from various sources

objectives.text: (a) Identify different ways/strategies for organising information from various sources
objectives.resources: Journals, written texts, newspapers, encyclopedias, magazines
objectives.assessment_criteria: Strategies for organising information from various sources are identified

objectives.text: (b) Sort and categorise information obtained from various sources into related themes
objectives.teaching_methods: I do, we do, you do (Gradual release of responsibility): Guide the students through using the “I do, you do” meth
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information obtained from various sources is sorted and categorized appropriately into related themes

objectives.text: (c) Compile information searched from various sources
objectives.teaching_methods: Project, I do, we do, you do
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information searched from various sources is compiled properly

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of English language skills

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and in written language tasks
competences: (a) Hold conversations about various contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary (structure: tenses, adverbs, adjectives, active and passive voice, conjunctions, coordinators, prepositions)
(b) Compose stories using proper grammar and vocabulary (structure: tenses, adverbs, adjectives, active and passive voice, conjunctions, coordinators, prepositions)
(c) Describe events (e.g., general elections, state funerals, world cup) using correct grammar and vocabulary

objectives.text: (a) Hold conversations about various contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary (structure: tenses, adverbs, adjectives, active and passive voice, conjunctions, coordinators, prepositions)
objectives.resources: Written texts of different types, dictionaries, encyclopaedias, oral texts, audio and audio - visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Conversations about various contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary are held

objectives.text: (b) Compose stories using proper grammar and vocabulary (structure: tenses, adverbs, adjectives, active and passive voice, conjunctions, coordinators, prepositions)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Stories using proper grammar and vocabulary are composed

objectives.text: (c) Describe events (e.g., general elections, state funerals, world cup) using correct grammar and vocabulary
objectives.assessment_criteria: Events are described by using correct grammar and vocabulary

sub_topics.title: Read texts for comprehension
competences: (a) Distinguish facts from opinions within a given text
(b) Express connotative meanings of words in relation to a text
(c) Paraphrase a given text

objectives.text: (a) Distinguish facts from opinions within a given text
objectives.teaching_methods: Questions and answers, Reading, Pair work
objectives.resources: Books, dictionaries, encyclopaedia, newspaper articles, journals
objectives.assessment_criteria: Facts and opinions within a given text are distinguished correctly

objectives.text: (b) Express connotative meanings of words in relation to a text
objectives.assessment_criteria: Connotative meanings of words in relation to a text are expressed appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Paraphrase a given text
objectives.assessment_criteria: A given text is paraphrased correctly

sub_topics.title: Comprehend oral messages with increasing difficulty
competences: (a) Discuss information from various oral sources
(b) Respond to various oral messages
(c) Make comments on oral messages

objectives.text: (a) Discuss information from various oral sources
objectives.resources: Oral texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information from various oral sources is discussed appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Respond to various oral messages
objectives.assessment_criteria: Various oral messages are responded to accordingly

objectives.text: (c) Make comments on oral messages
objectives.assessment_criteria: Oral messages are commented on precisely

sub_topics.title: Respond appropriately in a variety of oral and written communication contexts
competences: (a) Express ideas, opinions and facts in mass communication contexts
(b) Use and interpret appropriate non-verbal cues in mass communication
(c) Use appropriate language to respond to contextualised public messages (e.g., responding to criticism, accomplishment)
(d) Use appropriate language in public communication settings, (e.g., interviews, presentations)
(e) Express appreciation of other people’s ideas in public communication
(f) Evaluate information received through mass communication

objectives.text: (a) Express ideas, opinions and facts in mass communication contexts
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, a variety of texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Opinions and facts in mass communication are expressed clearly

objectives.text: (b) Use and interpret appropriate non-verbal cues in mass communication
objectives.assessment_criteria: Non-verbal cues in mass communication are interpreted and used appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Use appropriate language to respond to contextualised public messages (e.g., responding to criticism, accomplishment)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Contextualized public messages are responded to by using appropriate language

objectives.text: (d) Use appropriate language in public communication settings, (e.g., interviews, presentations)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Language in public communication/ settings is used appropriately

objectives.text: (e) Express appreciation of other people’s ideas in public communication
objectives.assessment_criteria: Appreciations of other people’s ideas in public communication are expressed suitably

objectives.text: (f) Evaluate information received through mass communication
objectives.teaching_methods: TIPS, Modelling, Shared practice, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.assessment_criteria: Information received through mass communication is evaluated appropriately

sub_topics.title: Construct meaning from a variety of texts
competences: (a) Compare ideas from various texts
(b) Read and generate meanings from a variety of texts
(c) Infer meanings of unfamiliar words from a variety of texts
(d) Paraphrase textual information from multiple sources

objectives.text: (a) Compare ideas from various texts
objectives.resources: Books, dictionaries, encyclopaedia, newspaper articles, journals
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ideas from various texts are compared correctly

objectives.text: (b) Read and generate meanings from a variety of texts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Meanings from a variety of texts are generated

objectives.text: (c) Infer meanings of unfamiliar words from a variety of texts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Meanings of unfamiliar words from a variety of texts are inferred correctly

objectives.text: (d) Paraphrase textual information from multiple sources
objectives.teaching_methods: I do, we do, you do, Modelling, Shared practice, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.assessment_criteria: Textual information from multiple sources is paraphrased properly

sub_topics.title: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary for oral communication in a variety of contexts
competences: (a) Express opinions through debates, dialogues and impromptu speeches using formulaic language (e.g., In my opinion…, personally…, I think …, I would say…, In my view…, from my perspective…, My point is…, It seems to me that…, I believe…)
(b) Present facts logically using appropriate formulaic language (e.g., due to the fact that…, it is true that…, the bottom line is…, the reality is…, in fact…actually… according to…)
(c) Describe conditions about various situations and circumstances (structure: conditional sentences)
(d) Ask and respond to questions in interview sessions (e.g., job interview, panel interview, TV/radio interview)
(e) Describe activities and events of a social or cultural nature (e.g., celebrations, parades, accidents, elections, funerals, sport and games) using different tenses

objectives.text: (a) Express opinions through debates, dialogues and impromptu speeches using formulaic language (e.g., In my opinion…, personally…, I think …, I would say…, In my view…, from my perspective…, My point is…, It seems to me that…, I believe…)
objectives.resources: Speakers, recorded materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories) on various situations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Opinions are expressed through debates, dialogues, and impromptu speeches using formulaic language

objectives.text: (b) Present facts logically using appropriate formulaic language (e.g., due to the fact that…, it is true that…, the bottom line is…, the reality is…, in fact…actually… according to…)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Facts are logically presented using appropriate formulaic language

objectives.text: (c) Describe conditions about various situations and circumstances (structure: conditional sentences)
objectives.teaching_methods: Investigation, Chain conditionals (Conditional train), Pelmanism (Concentration) game, Group discussion, Songs
objectives.assessment_criteria: Conditions about various situations and circumstances are described appropriately

objectives.text: (d) Ask and respond to questions in interview sessions (e.g., job interview, panel interview, TV/radio interview)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Interview questions are asked and responded to correctly

objectives.text: (e) Describe activities and events of a social or cultural nature (e.g., celebrations, parades, accidents, elections, funerals, sport and games) using different tenses
objectives.assessment_criteria: Social- cultural activities and events are described properly

sub_topics.title: Create a variety of texts for different communicative purposes using the appropriate tone and register
competences: (a) Write a letter to the editor, an order letter and a complaint letter (structure: Dear editor.., I would like to order…. We are glad to place our first order…, I am writing to complain about…, I am writing to bring your attention…, a complaint against…)
(b) Write reports on various events (e.g., sports, graduation, study tours)
(c) Write biographies (structure: past and present tense, third person)

objectives.text: (a) Write a letter to the editor, an order letter and a complaint letter (structure: Dear editor.., I would like to order…. We are glad to place our first order…, I am writing to complain about…, I am writing to bring your attention…, a complaint against…)
objectives.teaching_methods: Observation and discussion, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.resources: Relevant texts, dictionaries, samples of letter to the editor, order and complaint letters
objectives.assessment_criteria: Letter to the editor, order and complaint letters are written correctly

objectives.text: (b) Write reports on various events (e.g., sports, graduation, study tours)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Reports on various events are written appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Write biographies (structure: past and present tense, third person)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Biographies are written correctly

topics.title: Provide basic English language services to the community

sub_topics.title: Apply principles of editing and proofreading in a variety of texts
competences: (a) Recognise the basic principles of editing and proofreading texts (e.g., sentence construction, language clarity, grammar, semantic rules, logical flow)
(b) Describe the main steps of editing and proofreading
(c) Describe the basic principles and methods of editing and proofreading
(d) Use the principles of editing and proofreading to edit and proofread simple and short texts in a school context (e.g., laboratory rules, announcements)

objectives.text: (a) Recognise the basic principles of editing and proofreading texts (e.g., sentence construction, language clarity, grammar, semantic rules, logical flow)
objectives.resources: Relevant texts, school rules and regulations, fliers, user manuals, various essays/ compositions, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic principles of editing and proofreading are recognised

objectives.text: (b) Describe the main steps of editing and proofreading
objectives.assessment_criteria: The main steps in editing and proofreading are described accurately

objectives.text: (c) Describe the basic principles and methods of editing and proofreading
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic principles and methods of editing and proofreading are described properly

objectives.text: (d) Use the principles of editing and proofreading to edit and proofread simple and short texts in a school context (e.g., laboratory rules, announcements)
objectives.teaching_methods: Modelling, Shared practice, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.assessment_criteria: The principles of editing and proofreading simple texts in the school context are used appropriately

sub_topics.title: Apply principles of interpretation to provide simple authentic interpretations
competences: (a) Explain the concept of interpretation
(b) Elaborate the principles of interpretation
(c) Interpret a short simple text in a school context (e.g., greetings, self introductions) (English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

objectives.text: (a) Explain the concept of interpretation
objectives.teaching_methods: Know Want Learned (KWL) chart, Group work
objectives.resources: Dictionaries, oral texts, audio and audio-visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of interpretation is explained accurately

objectives.text: (b) Elaborate the principles of interpretation
objectives.assessment_criteria: The principles of interpretation are elaborated precisely

objectives.text: (c) Interpret a short simple text in a school context (e.g., greetings, self introductions) (English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Short messages in the school context are interpreted appropriately

sub_topics.title: Apply principles of translation to produce simple authentic translation
competences: (a) Explain the concept of translation
(b) Elaborate the principles of translation
(c) Translate a simple short text in a school context (e.g., laboratory rules, timetables, joining instructions) (English to Kiswahili and vice versa)

objectives.text: (a) Explain the concept of translation
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of translation is explained correctly

objectives.text: (b) Elaborate the principles of translation
objectives.assessment_criteria: The principles of translation are elaborated correctly

objectives.text: (c) Translate a simple short text in a school context (e.g., laboratory rules, timetables, joining instructions) (English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
objectives.teaching_methods: I do, we do, you do, Modelling, Shared practice, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.assessment_criteria: Texts in the school context are translated correctly

sub_topics.title: Appreciate the aesthetics and value of literature
competences: (a) Assess the language used in selected poems and plays
(b) Compare own values and perspectives with those implied in selected poems and plays

objectives.text: (a) Assess the language used in selected poems and plays
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Shared practice, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.resources: Literary texts, audio/ audio-visual materials, artistic drawings, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: The language used in selected poems and plays is assessed appropriately.

objectives.text: (b) Compare own values and perspectives with those implied in selected poems and plays
objectives.assessment_criteria: Own values and perspectives are compared appropriately with those implied in selected poems and plays

sub_topics.title: Evaluate the context in which literary texts are written, read and understood
competences: (a) Assess the socio-political and cultural contexts in which the selected poems and plays were written
(b) Examine the socio-political, economic and cultural issues portrayed in selected poems and plays
(c) Relate the context of the story in selected poems and plays with real life experiences

objectives.text: (a) Assess the socio-political and cultural contexts in which the selected poems and plays were written
objectives.resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: The socio-political and cultural contexts in which the selected poems and plays were written are assessed appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Examine the socio-political, economic and cultural issues portrayed in selected poems and plays
objectives.assessment_criteria: The socio-political, economic and cultural issues portrayed in selected poems and plays are examined appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Relate the context of the story in selected poems and plays with real life experiences
objectives.assessment_criteria: The context of the story in selected poems and plays is related properly with real-life experiences

sub_topics.title: Analyse genres of literature and appreciate their conventions
competences: (a) Describe different genres of written literature and their conventions
(b) Analyse techniques of critiquing poems and plays based on their conventions
(c) Critique selected poems and plays based on form and content

objectives.text: (a) Describe different genres of written literature and their conventions
objectives.teaching_methods: Two Truths and a Lie, Discussion/Group work
objectives.resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: Different genres of literature and their conventions are described correctly

objectives.text: (b) Analyse techniques of critiquing poems and plays based on their conventions
objectives.assessment_criteria: Techniques for critiquing poems and plays based on their conventions are analysed appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Critique selected poems and plays based on form and content
objectives.assessment_criteria: Poems and plays are clearly critiqued based on form and content

sub_topics.title: Create simple literary works
competences: (a) Compose free verse poems on various topics using literary language
(b) Publish the poems on various platforms (e.g., note boards and online platforms)

objectives.text: (a) Compose free verse poems on various topics using literary language
objectives.teaching_methods: Think-aloud-pair problem solving, Collaborative and independent practice
objectives.resources: Literary texts, audio/ audio-visual materials(audio/ video clips, recorded stories), artistic drawings, dictionaries
objectives.assessment_criteria: Topics for composing poems are identified appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Publish the poems on various platforms (e.g., note boards and online platforms)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Poems are published properly on various platforms
